19:52.text: And We called him from the side of the mount
right and brought him near, confiding

19:53.text: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.

19:54.text: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.

19:55.text: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakāh and was to his Lord pleasing

19:56.text: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.

19:57.text: And We raised him to a high station.

19:58.text: Those were the ones upon whom Allāh bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried
with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel
, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.

19:59.text: But there came after them successors
who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil

19:60.text: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.

19:61.text: gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been eminent.

19:62.text: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only
peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.

19:63.text: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allāh.

19:64.text: descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -
